text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Training with Curren Chan at summer camp is going well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whew…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: What's next on the list, Big Bro?

text_block_list.text: What's next on the list, Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm… I've still got a bit left in me. Can we take the break after that instead?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Summer camp's almost over. I wanna try and get a little bit more in.
choice_data_list: …Are you in a hurry or something?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't say that. It's just…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I don't think I have what it takes to be the most beloved runner yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to be at a standstill, but pushing herself harder than she is right now isn't going to help her.
choice_data_list: I really think we should take a break.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okay. Sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan seems to be thinking about something. She doesn't touch her phone even once during the break. Hoping to help her relax, I talk to her.
choice_data_list: Want to take a picture for Umastagram?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Seriously? All right, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The theme is "Curren's Sparkling Days"! Let me go wash my face real quick.
choice_data_list: You can't just take it the way you are now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Obviously not! My hair's all messed up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I can't post a pic looking like this. I've got to be cute!
choice_data_list: I think you look more than good enough the way you are.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I know what you're trying to say, but… seeing everyone trying so hard has really moved me too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But I think my cuteness really thrives most in races.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Plus, I don't think my followers are really interested in seeing me train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan's stance doesn't change. But as someone who knows how hard she works behind the scenes, it seems like a waste to keep it hidden.
choice_data_list: I think it'd make me want to cheer for you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You already cheer for me… Or is that not what you mean?
choice_data_list: I mean it would make you more relatable.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Relatable?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Umamusume all run for different reasons—to achieve their dreams, to live up to others' expectations, to defeat a rival…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash was like this too. She wasn't very popular with fans, but she kept winning and rose among the ranks. And there's nothing people love more than watching an underdog story unfold.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: A story…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: All right… Okay… I got it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Big Bro! I was being kinda narrow-minded.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Big Sis! I was being kinda narrow-minded.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I know what I need to do now. And it's so simple!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's just like before—I did an interview, answered questions, and people read about it. I need to do that again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's not that I myself need to change. I just need to change how I do things. Right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's not that I myself need to change. I just need to change how I do things. Right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe! I found my answer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I think I'm feeling a bit better! I'm gonna go take a video of myself training right now. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan

text_block_list.text: I have no idea why she's suddenly changed her mind, but if she's willing to film her training, then I'm going to help.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If we're going to do this, we might as well go all out! Let's give them a taste of some real training.

text_block_list.text: Hurry up, Big Bro!
